title: Understanding the Role of σ²
text: In the context of the true linear model, σ² represents the variance of the error term $$\epsilon_i$$. This variance is a fixed quantity that characterizes the distribution of the error terms.

title: Fixed Quantities in the Model
text: Consider what aspects of the model are predetermined and do not change. The variance of the error term, σ², is one such aspect.
